Hi Avery / Tom,

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our 25-minute discovery:

- Current infra: single-region AWS, heavy batch workloads, 1–2 inference endpoints today.
- Primary goals: reduce per-query latency to <200ms p50 for interactive features and lower token cost for high-volume embeddings.
- Success metrics: 30% cost reduction within 3 months + consistent 99th percentile latency budget.
- Security drivers: SOC2 compliance incoming, need audit logs and KMS integration for keys.

Next step: technical demo + configuration deep-dive with Rishi (solutions) — 30 minutes focused on expected throughput, quantization tradeoffs, and rollout strategy. Can you lock one of these tight slots? If we don't hear back I’ll release them later today. Please reply with the slot you prefer and I’ll send the invite.

Option A — Tue 8/3 09:00–09:30 PT
Option B — Tue 8/3 11:30–12:00 PT
Option C — Wed 8/4 10:00–10:30 PT

I’ve attached a short intro deck and a one-pager on security that Rishi will reference.

Thanks — quick confirmation appreciated, we’re trying to lock engineering calendars.

Best,
